# Assets

* Tiny Swords Free Pack (`Buildings`, `Terrain`, `Units`, `UI Elements`, `Particle FX`): third-party art, see its licence.
* `fonts/`: Noto Sans and Press Start 2P (SIL OFL).
* `sounds/`: generated by `tools/gen_sounds.py` (procedural synthesis, fixed seed, self-made, public domain / CC0). No downloaded content; re-run the script to rewrite them.
* `ui/`: Tiled maps for UI panels, generated by `tools/gen_ui_maps.py`.
* `shaders/`: GLSL 330 fragment shaders (outline, dissolve, flash, water, post, bloom).
